en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 9. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakil who said

it was narrated to me by Ali b. al-Hussain al-Sa’dabadi from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from al-Bazanti b. Ali from Hareez from some of his companions from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “If a man swears falsely due to which there is a loss of wealth or right of a Muslim, he has made Hell obligatory on himself.”
